data.claim: AIPAC sought to prevent annexation disputes from weakening U.S. aid and the bilateral relationship.

sources.title: AIPAC urges U.S. not to weaken relationship over annexation
AIPAC gives lawmakers latitude to criticize annexation without threatening aid

summary: Public reporting records AIPAC opposing degradation of U.S.–Israel ties over annexation while allowing criticism that did not threaten aid or fundamentals of the relationship.
title: AIPAC sought to shield aid and bilateral ties from annexation consequences
